BiblicalUsage: Machsoph is the peeling, the stripping back, and it appears once, in Genesis 30:37, where Jacob pilled white strakes in the rods and made the white appear which was in them.
TheologicalSignificance: I take it as one of Jacob's shrewdest moments: he peeled the rods to make the white show, and the white was there all along.
